## Description {#details}

<p>An unexpanded parameter pack (either in the expression or type context).</p>


<p>If this AST is correct, this node will have a <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/parameterpackexpansion">ParameterPackExpansion</a> node above it.</p>


<p>This node is created when some &lt;template-args&gt; are found that apply to an &lt;encoding&gt;, and is stored in the TemplateParams table. In order for this to appear in the final AST, it has to referenced via a &lt;template-param&gt; (ie, T_).</p>


<p>Definition at line 1394 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/demangle/itaniumdemangle-h">ItaniumDemangle.h</a>.</p>
